description: Binary nDCG@10 and @20 added to every run, to show how high the cited chunks sit in the prompt; every metric now describes itself in the file. Same pipelines as V1; Recall@10 still decides.

metrics.name: Recall@10
metrics.what: The share of a question's cited chunks found among the first 10 chunks of the run's list.
metrics.how: The number of cited chunks ranked 1 to 10, divided by the number of cited chunks. Averaged over the questions, each weighing the same.
metrics.represents: How much of what a correct answer needs reaches the prompt, which holds the first 10 chunks of the run's list.

metrics.name: Recall@20
metrics.what: The share of a question's cited chunks found among the first 20 chunks of the run's list.
metrics.how: The number of cited chunks ranked 1 to 20, divided by the number of cited chunks. Averaged over the questions, each weighing the same.
metrics.represents: How much of what a correct answer needs reaches the first 20 chunks of the run's list: what a retriever hands to the next step, and the prompt of the 20-chunk variant.

metrics.name: Binary nDCG@10
metrics.what: How high the cited chunks sit among the first 10, from 0 to 1.
metrics.how: Every cited chunk gains 1 and any other chunk 0. A gain at rank r is worth 1 / log2(r + 1): 1 first, 0.5 third, 0.29 tenth. The sum is divided by the sum of the best ranking, every cited chunk first. Averaged over the questions.
metrics.represents: How high the cited chunks sit inside the prompt, which holds the first 10 chunks of the run's list, and how many get there: 1 only when the cited chunks take the first places, as many as fit. A question's only cited chunk, ranked 10th, keeps its whole Recall@10 but scores 0.29.

metrics.name: Binary nDCG@20
metrics.what: How high the cited chunks sit among the first 20, from 0 to 1.
metrics.how: Every cited chunk gains 1 and any other chunk 0. A gain at rank r is worth 1 / log2(r + 1): 1 first, 0.5 third, 0.29 tenth. The sum is divided by the sum of the best ranking, every cited chunk first. Averaged over the questions.
metrics.represents: How high the cited chunks sit inside the first 20 chunks of the run's list: what a retriever hands to the next step, and the prompt of the 20-chunk variant, and how many get there: 1 only when the cited chunks take the first places, as many as fit. A question's only cited chunk, ranked 20th, keeps its whole Recall@20 but scores 0.23.

metrics.name: MRR
metrics.what: How early the first cited chunk comes.
metrics.how: 1 / the rank of the first cited chunk, at any depth: 1 first, 0.5 second, 0.1 tenth; 0 when the run leaves out every cited chunk. Averaged over the questions.
metrics.represents: How soon the list gives a useful chunk: 0.5 can mean that every question's first cited chunk is second. It says nothing about the other cited chunks.

metrics.name: Questions
metrics.how: The answerable questions of the split, or of one category. An unanswerable question has no cited chunk to find.
metrics.represents: How much one question weighs in a score: 1 / the number of questions. A small category moves a lot with one question.

metrics.name: Candidates
metrics.what: How many chunks a run ranks for a question.
metrics.how: The length of the list the run's last step returns, averaged over the questions.
metrics.represents: Context, not a score: a list of the whole corpus holds every cited chunk. Read it with the end of the recall curve.

metrics.name: Recall curve
metrics.what: Recall@k for every k, from 1 to the longest list.
metrics.how: At each k, Recall@k averaged over the questions. Past the end of its own list, a question keeps the recall its whole list reached.
metrics.represents: Runs compared at the same number of chunks. Its last value is the share of the cited chunks among every chunk ranked: after the expansion, the most a reranker could keep.

metrics.name: Latency p50
metrics.what: How long the pipeline takes for a typical question.
metrics.how: The time of every step, added up for each question. The p50 is the time half of the questions take no longer than.
metrics.represents: What a user waits for retrieval, on the machine that ran the evaluation. Lower is better.

metrics.name: Latency p95
metrics.what: How long the pipeline takes for its slowest questions.
metrics.how: The time of every step, added up for each question. The p95 is the time 95% of the questions take no longer than.
metrics.represents: What a user waits for retrieval, on the machine that ran the evaluation. Lower is better.
